correctness.rationale: Geometric smoothness follows from the gradient and elementary-symmetric sign pattern. The 120-permutation GF9 row reduction is a complete finite proof of the 27 explicit lines and six Frobenius conjugate pairs. An analytic sign-pattern count yields #F3=25; all lines over F9 and standard smooth cubic Picard generation force eigenvalues ±1 with trace 5, hence 6 positive, 1 negative. The uniform point counts and zeta then follow by the smooth projective surface trace formula. Finite checker independently establishes #F9=145; no infinite claim rests solely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The primitive characteristic-three Clebsch model is a natural exceptional-fiber surface for which naive power-sum specialization collapses. Its precise Frobenius class and complete 27-line Galois splitting are meaningful intrinsic arithmetic invariants, distinguishing the split vs reflection options of general theory. The one explicit 25-point calculation yields the zeta function and counts over every extension, not merely a small numerical example.
